title: On the Cauchy problem for the Tzitzéica equation: Soliton resolution conjecture and asymptotic analysis
summary: We prove the soliton resolution conjecture for the Tzitzéica equation, which is an important integrable model arising in affine differential geometry and characterizing proper affine spheres. Recently, Huang, Wang and Zhu (Math. Ann. \textbf{395}, 18 (2026)) reported the long-time asymptotic result for the Tzitzéica equation with purely continuous spectrum. Inspired by their work, we carry out a full asymptotic analysis of the Tzitzéica equation.
